## 2. Platform Architecture & Service Offerings

Primadev Store is an automated e-commerce and license distribution infrastructure built on Next.js 16 App Router, Firebase Realtime Database, Midtrans Payment Gateway, and automated PDF invoice compilation engines.

### Primary Capabilities:
1. **Catalog Browsing & Direct Purchase**: Customers can explore official software suites, choose subscription durations (Monthly, Yearly, Lifetime), and pay through automated gateways.
2. **Real-time 24/7 License Generation**: Once payment status reaches settlement or accepted capture, license keys are generated instantly via cryptographic random seeds and registered into the licensing database.
3. **Automated License Renewal**: Existing users can renew active or expired licenses by providing their license key. Accumulated expiration dates are calculated dynamically without requiring app re-installation.
4. **License Validity Verification**: Public lookup endpoint to check activation status, registered application, registered holder, and remaining duration.
5. **PDF Invoicing**: Compliant electronic PDF receipts with QRIS/transaction tracking, license box, and official corporate address.
6. **Bilingual Support**: Fully localized in Bahasa Indonesia and English.

## 3. Detailed Software Catalog

### Product 1: Struk SPBU Generator Android
- **Identifier**: `struk-spbu` / `spbu-struk`
- **Target Platform**: Android Smartphone & Tablet
- **Primary Audience**: SPBU Operators, Fleet Managers, Logistics Coordinators, Transportation Businesses.
- **Key Features**:
  - Accurate thermal receipt generation for all major gas stations (Pertamina, Shell, BP AKR, Vivo).
  - Bluetooth thermal printer connection (58mm & 80mm).
  - Dynamic fuel pricing calculations (Pertalite, Pertamax, Solar, Dexlite, Shell Super, V-Power).
  - Custom vehicle plate numbers, operator IDs, nozzle numbers, and shift reports.
  - Offline mode with instant local saving and PDF/image export.
- **Pricing**:
  - Monthly Plan: IDR 80,000 / month
  - Yearly Plan: IDR 860,000 / year (Discounted / Best Value)

### Product 2: KasirQ POS (Point of Sale)
- **Identifier**: `kasir_q` / `kasirq`
- **Target Platform**: Android POS & Mobile
- **Primary Audience**: MSMEs (UMKM), Cafes, Restaurants, Grocery Stores, Retail Shops.
- **Key Features**:
  - Fast item checkout with barcode scanner integration (camera or Bluetooth hardware).
  - Real-time inventory tracking, low-stock warnings, and cost of goods sold (HPP) calculations.
  - Multi-payment tracking (Cash, QRIS, Transfer, Credit/Debit).
  - Daily, weekly, and monthly sales analytics with profit-loss summaries.
  - Cashier shift management and receipt branding.

### Product 3: WA Direct & Automation Blaster Pro
- **Identifier**: `wa-direct` / `whatsapp_direct`
- **Target Platform**: Android App & Browser Extension
- **Primary Audience**: Online Sellers, Customer Service Teams, Real Estate Agents, Marketers.
- **Key Features**:
  - Direct WhatsApp chat initiation without saving recipient phone numbers to contact list.
  - Scheduled follow-up reminders and pre-formatted quick reply templates.
  - Broadcast message delivery with dynamic contact tag substitution.
  - Anti-ban delay throttling and message spinning support.

## 4. Licensing Life Cycle & Security Model

```
[User Selects Product] 
       │
       ▼
[Server-Side Price Lookup from Firebase] ──> (Client never supplies price)
       │
       ▼
[Midtrans Gateway Charge Request] ──> (QRIS / VA / E-Wallet)
       │
       ▼
[Waiting Payment & Polling / Webhook Sync]
       │
       ├──> [Atomic Lock on Transaction Status: pending -> processing]
       │
       ▼
[Cryptographic License Key Generated & Saved]
       │
       ├──> Displayed immediately on `/thankyou`
       ├──> Dispatched via Nodemailer HTML template to Customer Email
       └──> Exported on official PDF Invoice (`/api/invoice?id=...`)
```

### Security Guardrails:
- **Zero Client-Side Price Reliance**: Product prices are strictly queried from Firebase backend based on sanitized `appId` and `duration`.
- **Atomic Double-Fulfillment Protection**: Distributed transactions prevent race conditions between webhooks and frontend polling.
- **Strict Webhook Validation**: SHA-512 cryptographic signature verification with Midtrans Server Key and exact `gross_amount` cross-checking.
- **Device Binding**: Keys bind to unique device IDs to prevent unauthorized sharing or piracy.
- **Input Sanitization**: `appId`, `licenseKey`, and customer data are sanitized against path-traversal and injection attacks.

## 5. Payment Methods & Verification

| Payment Method | Provider / Channel | Activation Speed | Instructions |
|---|---|---|---|
| **QRIS** | All Indonesian Banks & E-Wallets | Instant (< 3s) | Scan dynamic QR code via BCA, Mandiri, BRI, GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay |
| **BCA Virtual Account** | Bank Central Asia | Instant | Transfer via BCA Mobile, KlikBCA, or BCA ATM |
| **Mandiri Bill** | Bank Mandiri (eChannel) | Instant | Pay via Livin by Mandiri using Biller Code and Bill Key |
| **BNI Virtual Account** | Bank Negara Indonesia | Instant | Transfer via BNI Mobile Banking or BNI ATM |
| **BRI Virtual Account** | Bank Rakyat Indonesia | Instant | Pay via BRImo or BRI ATM using BRIVA number |
| **Permata VA** | Bank Permata | Instant | Transfer via PermataNet, PermataMobile, or Prima/Bersama ATM |
| **CIMB Niaga VA** | Bank CIMB Niaga | Instant | Pay via OCTO Mobile or CIMB Niaga ATM |
| **GoPay / ShopeePay / DANA / OVO** | Direct E-Wallet | Instant | Auto-redirect or app deeplink confirmation |
| **Indomaret / Alfamart** | Retail Outlets | Real-time | Show payment code to cashier |

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q1: How do I receive my License Key after completing the payment?
**Answer**: Your license key is presented immediately on the success page upon transaction confirmation and simultaneously sent to your registered email address along with the official PDF invoice.

### Q2: Can I renew my software license before the current period expires?
**Answer**: Yes. Navigate to [https://store.primadev.id/renew](https://store.primadev.id/renew), input your active License Key, and select your preferred renewal duration. The system will automatically add the new duration to your existing expiry date without resetting your app data.

### Q3: What should I do if my License Key shows "Expired" or "Device Mismatch"?
**Answer**: You can check your license status anytime at [https://store.primadev.id/check-license](https://store.primadev.id/check-license). If you changed your device or need assistance resetting device bindings, submit a ticket at [https://store.primadev.id/support](https://store.primadev.id/support) or message our WhatsApp helpline at +62 838-2952-0561.

### Q4: Do I get an official invoice for company expense reports?
**Answer**: Yes. An official electronic PDF invoice complete with corporate registration info, transaction ID, product breakdown, and license details is automatically generated for every transaction and can be accessed at `/api/invoice?id={order_or_license_id}`.

---

## 7. Developer & API Endpoints Summary

- `GET /api/public_order`: Returns public catalog and portfolio list.
- `POST /api/public_order`:
  - `action: "create_transaction"`: Initiates new purchase.
  - `action: "renew_transaction"`: Initiates license renewal.
  - `action: "verify_payment"`: Checks payment settlement status and triggers fulfillment.
  - `action: "cancel_transaction"`: Cancels uncompleted transactions.
- `GET /api/licenses?id={key}`: Public license lookup by key.
- `POST /api/validate-license`: In-app license check with device binding verification.
- `GET /api/invoice?id={id}`: Generates downloadable A4 PDF invoice.
- `POST /api/contact`: Submits customer support inquiries.
- `POST /api/webhook`: Secure Midtrans notification handler.
